description: Source code for the LayerTracing class in the Android SurfaceFlinger service, managing layer trace data collection, buffering, and file output.

classes.name: LayerTracing
classes.description: Manages tracing of layer operations, including enabling/disabling tracing, buffering trace data, and writing trace files.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables layer tracing, initializing buffer size.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables tracing and optionally writes trace data to a file.

methods.name: appendToStream
methods.description: Appends current trace data to an output stream.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if tracing is currently enabled.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Writes trace data to a specified file.

methods.name: setTraceFlags
methods.description: Sets tracing flags for filtering trace entries.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the trace buffer.

methods.name: flagIsSet
methods.description: Checks if specific trace flags are set.

methods.name: createTraceFileProto
methods.description: Creates a trace file header with metadata.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs current tracing state and buffer contents.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Records a trace event with associated layer and display info.
